articles.title: District Six Restitution Housing / Jakupa Architects and Urban Designers
articles.summary: The District Six Restitution Housing Project provides 108 homes for land claimants returning to the heart of Cape Town . The project draws inspiration from the historic District Six, characterized by intimate streetscapes, vibrant public life, and close-knit community ties prior to the forced removals of 1966.

articles.title: House OY / 1-1 Architects
articles.summary: This house is located in an urbanization control area in Anjo City, Aichi Prefecture. The client acquired the site by developing farmland under a branch-family provision, which resulted in a plot that is unusually large for a single residence. The surrounding environment consists of scattered fields, vinyl greenhouses, and small work sheds—forming a landscape of repeated, fine-grained building scales that differs from the uniformity of the city.

articles.title: The Nimbus - uBLOCK Healthcare Hospitality Lounge / LUKSTUDIO
articles.summary: Lukstudio was invited by Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare to transform a 130-square-meter standalone building in Yishan Road Business Plaza into a ground-floor café and a second-floor private VIP lounge. Inspired by the concept of a "tribe", the design softens traditional medical boundaries, blurring lines between doctors and patients, interior and exterior, and formality and casualness, while using light to create a welcoming, healing environment.

articles.title: Hostafrancs House / Parramon + Tahull Arquitectes
articles.summary: The original space was a gloomy top-floor apartment with scarce light, small windows, and low ceilings. It featured a poorly insulated roof prone to leaks, with a terrace on one side and a porch on the other that were barely connected to the interior.

articles.title: Lima House / BLOCO Arquitetos
articles.summary: The house is located on a plot in Lago Sul, a residential neighborhood in Brasília. Although the project was designed in 2016, its construction was completed in two phases, the first in 2018 and the second in 2024. One of the premises of the project was to distribute the entire internal area of the house on a single level. This way, the slight slope of the topography is only noticeable in the elevation of the open area around the pool in relation to the natural ground level.

articles.title: Linho House / TETRO Arquitetura
articles.summary: Located in a residential neighborhood in Nova Lima , Minas Gerais, the Linho House is more than just a residence—it is a narrative crafted in architecture. Directly inspired by its inhabitant, a fashion designer who works with fabrics and sewing, the house translates the essence of her creative daily life into forms and materials.
